options.content:
# VoltDB configuration

Below's information comes from @SystemInformation call, for detailed description please go to [documentation](https://docs.voltdb.com/UsingVoltDB/sysprocsysteminfo.php#sysprocsysinforetvalovervw).

panels.description: VoltDB software version (VERSION) reported by @SystemInformation OVERVIEW.
panels.title: Version

panels.description: How long the cluster has been running, derived from the start timestamp (STARTTIME / HOSTSTARTTIME) reported by @SystemInformation OVERVIEW.
panels.title: Uptime

panels.description: One of INITIALIZING, RUNNING, PAUSED, SHUTTINGDOWN
panels.title: Cluster state

panels.description: One of REDUCED, FULL
panels.title: Cluster safety

panels.description: Initial (configured) cluster size from @SystemInformation OVERVIEW (FULLCLUSTERSIZE) — the number of nodes the cluster was started with.
panels.title: Full cluster size

panels.description: Current number of nodes in the cluster, counted from the per-host @SystemInformation OVERVIEW rows.
panels.title: Current size

panels.description: Cluster configuration summary from @SystemInformation OVERVIEW: VoltDB build string (BUILDSTRING), DR replication role (REPLICATIONROLE), and whether the cluster is running on Kubernetes.
panels.title: Configuration overview

panels.description: K-safety value (kfactor) from @SystemInformation DEPLOYMENT — the number of redundant copies kept of each partition.
panels.title: kFactor

panels.description: Number of CPU cores on the host (CPUCORES) reported by @SystemInformation OVERVIEW.
panels.title: CPU Cores

panels.description: Number of processor threads on the host (CPUTHREADS) reported by @SystemInformation OVERVIEW.
panels.title: CPU Threads

panels.description: DR cluster identifier (CLUSTERID) reported by @SystemInformation OVERVIEW.
panels.title: Cluster id

panels.description: Number of execution sites per host (sitesperhost) from @SystemInformation DEPLOYMENT.
panels.title: sites per host

panels.description: Database deployment settings from @SystemInformation DEPLOYMENT: DR role (drrole) and DR transaction priority (drpriority), elastic rebalance target duration (elasticduration, ms) and throughput (elasticthroughput, MB/s), whether export is enabled (export), heartbeat timeout (heartbeattimeout, seconds), and whether network partition detection is enabled (partitiondetection).

elasticduration.text: target duration of rebalance transactions in milliseconds

elasticthroughput.text: target throughput of rebalance transactions in MB/second

temptablesmaxsize.text: maximum size of the temp tables

targets.expr: max (voltdb_systeminformation_deployment_info{v2="1", namespace="$cluster", host_name=~"$host"}) by (drpriority,drrole, elasticduration, elasticthroughput, export, heartbeattimeout, partitiondetection, prioritiesenabled, temptablesmaxsize, metrics, memorylimit, drconsumermaxbuffers, drconsumermaxbytes)

panels.title: Deployment configuration

panels.description: Command logging settings: whether it is enabled, the mode (synchronous or asynchronous), the disk space reserved for command logs (in MB), and how often data is flushed to disk - both by time (in milliseconds) and by number of transactions.

commandlogfreqtime.text: frequency of cmd logging in milliseconds

commandlogfreqtxns.text: frequency of cmd logging in number of transactions

commandlogmode.text: cmd logging mode, sync or async

targets.expr: max (voltdb_systeminformation_commandlog_info{v2="1", namespace="$cluster", host_name=~"$host"}) by (commandlogenabled, commandlogfreqtime, commandlogfreqtxns, commandlogmode, commandlogsize)

panels.title: Command Log Configuration

panels.description: Automatic snapshot configuration from @SystemInformation DEPLOYMENT: whether automatic snapshots are enabled (snapshotenabled), their frequency (snapshotfrequency), system priority (snapshotpriority), and the number of snapshots retained (snapshotretain).

targets.expr: max (voltdb_systeminformation_snapshot_info{v2="1", namespace="$cluster", host_name=~"$host"}) by (snapshotenabled, snapshotfrequency, snapshotpriority, snapshotretain)

panels.title: Snapshot configuration

panels.description: Time remaining until the active license expires, derived from the license expiration date (EXPIRATION) reported by @SystemInformation LICENSE.
panels.title: License expires in

panels.description: The date the active license expires (EXPIRATION) from @SystemInformation LICENSE.
panels.title: License expires on

panels.description: Maximum number of hosts permitted by the active license (HOSTCOUNT_MAX) from @SystemInformation LICENSE.
panels.title: Host count limit

panels.description: Maximum number of processor cores permitted by the active license (CORECOUNT_MAX) from @SystemInformation LICENSE.
panels.title: Cores count limit

panels.description: The maximum Java memory (heap) the VoltDB server is allowed to use, set when the server starts. If usage approaches this limit the server can pause or run out of memory.
panels.title: Max Java heap
